name: BSS B2B Solution
summary: Shopify wholesale pricing app that sets price rules by customer tag and runs B2B registration forms with approval; the free plan covers one rule and one form on a live store.
best_for: Shopify stores that sell wholesale to tagged customers and want price rules and a signup form without building a second store
skip_if: you need a checkout test with the wholesale price before you install, or you want one flat price with no add-ons for credit limits, invoices or recurring orders
honest_knock: The free plan covers only 1 custom pricing rule and 1 registration form on live stores, and the approval screen in our test offered only Platinum at $99. Several features cost extra as add-ons, such as Credit limit at $39 and Recurring orders at $99. After we saved our rule, the app embed was still off.

Essential is $29 a month or $313.20 a year, Advanced is $49 a month or $529.20 a year and Platinum is $99 a month or $1,069.20 a year, each with a 14 day free trial. Add-ons per month: Invoice PDF $12, Recurring orders $99, Quick Order $9, Credit limit $39 and Sales rep $29 with 3 reps plus $9 per extra rep. On our development store Shopify showed Platinum as a test charge of $99.00 every 30 days and we paid nothing.

sessions.what: Our AI assistant ran the test on 21 November 2026 on a Shopify development store with the Basic plan, in the real admin with the interface in English. We installed BSS B2B Wholesale Pricing from its Shopify App Store page, created a price rule of 10% off for customers tagged wholesale and opened the plan approval screen. About 1 minute 30 seconds passed between pressing Install and the rule being live. Shopify marked the plan as a test charge that is not billed, so we paid nothing.
findings: Install: the Shopify dialog asked for view access to customer data, device and activity data and staff and contributor data, and to view and edit customers, products, orders, discounts, the Online Store and custom data.

Price rule: we created a rule named Wholesale price for tagged customers, with the tag wholesale and a 10% reduction. It showed as active about 90 seconds after install. The app embed was still switched off after we saved the rule, and the app showed a warning next to the rule until we turned it on.

Plan: the approval screen showed Platinum Plan (Monthly) at $99.00 every 30 days with a 14 day free trial ending on 5 December, and the line "You will not be billed for this test charge". No card was asked for. It was the only plan the screen offered us at that moment.
Listing: the Shopify App Store page showed a rating of 4.9 from 1,204 reviews, a Built for Shopify badge and a free plan. We did not check those reviews ourselves.
not_tested: Not tested: the B2B registration form, the approval workflow, a checkout with the wholesale price, and the plans below Platinum.
Not tested: paying. Shopify showed a test charge on our development store, so we cannot say how the trial converts or what a real invoice looks like.
